title: Wonderlands
summary: Shape an ocean planet, connect rivers, and discover a world of your own.
controls: Choose a terrain tool and paint. Use the game’s zoom and pan controls to inspect the world.
limitations: The game is visual. Saves are browser-local; local-server saves do not transfer automatically to the public site.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: An ocean planet with a painted island, mountains and a river.
